newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin had talks with U.S. State Secretary Madeleine Albright regarding Romania's bid to join NATO in the first wave of expansion.
* Hungary and Romania will support eachother in their bids to join NATO in the first wave, Hungarian Defence Minister Gyorgy Keleti said after talks with his Romanian counterpart Victor Babiuc.
Babiuc and Keleti signed a letter asking their German and French counterparts for support in setting a joint Romanian- Hungarian peacekeeping force paterned on the French-German model.
